text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian government adopts a draft law on the use of flags of national minorities according to which the flags can be used in private life, during cultural, sports and other events. In municipalities where national minorities are the majority population can raise national flags only on Macedonian national holidays.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov met on Tuesday Chinese Prime Minister Lee Peng and foreign minister Qien Qichen. Priority was given to economic cooperation.
- Court administration employees are on the second day of strike. The Bar Association supports the strike and state administration employees are also expected to back it.

- The holy Synod of the Serbian Orthodox Church explained that the appointment of Patriarch Pavle as administrator of the Macedonian Orthodox Church has grounds because Serbs in Macedonia are the poorest population in the state without the liberty to express their religion.
- Russian and Macedonian leaders expected to meet by end of year. Macedonian defence minister to sign a military cooperation agreement in Moscow in the second half of July.

- Macedonian government decided to issue a tender for granting concessions for the construction of the Skopje-Tetovo and Gradsko-Gevgelija roads. The concessions will granted for a period from 10 to 15 years. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
